caveats: Baseline has one fresh repetition; final has three. This comparison does not establish statistical FPS equality or a small FPS gain.
CPU groups are exclusive sampled endpoint estimates. Blocking endpoint attribution is kept separate and is not syscall execution cost.
Physical symbols retain library identity and RVA. Same-named clones are not collapsed or pooled across runs.
Per-frame CPU values use full benchmark FPS for a smaller CPU crop and are approximate sums across threads, not wall frame duration.
Wall stages overlap; do not add them. Native CPU sampling does not measure GPU pass work duration.
LOD summaries, queue counters, budget maxima and retry totals cover the whole record, including loading and warmup. Final gauges are snapshots.
No retry events before/after startup claim is inferred from aggregate counters; saved timestamped log events are retained.
Terminal missing drawable can occur at teardown. Periodic healthy proof bounds CPU analysis; it does not prove pixel correctness.
Visual QA is archived manual image comparison, separate from source geometry and invariant counters.
Smoke acceptance uses permissive performance thresholds; passed is not proof of a target FPS gate.
Reported process peak memory is unavailable when null; RSS monitors are separate saved evidence.
